title: the sound of a pumpkin
camera: Calm mirrorless footage with a 50mm lens: the subject sharp, the background softly out of focus, quiet natural colours, real grain.

light.morning: Early morning in late autumn, soft cool grey daylight, low white mist lying in the valley below the terraces.
light.late morning: Late morning in late autumn, bright soft overcast daylight, the mist lifting off the hills.
light.afternoon: Afternoon in late autumn, soft clear daylight from the open lattice window, bright, not golden.
light.dusk: Dusk in late autumn, soft blue fading daylight over the valley and one plain warm bulb on under the eaves; everything clearly visible.

outfits.walk: a loose undyed linen jacket with wide sleeves tied at the waist, wide flax-grey trousers, dark cloth shoes
outfits.kitchen: the undyed linen jacket with the wide sleeves rolled to the forearm, a dark-indigo linen apron, wide flax-grey trousers
outfits.supper: a soft oatmeal wool cardigan over the undyed linen jacket, wide flax-grey trousers

places.terraces: a terraced hillside kitchen garden above a misty green valley: narrow earth terraces held up by old mossy dry-stone walls, pumpkin vines with big rough leaves sprawling over a low bamboo trellis, rows of greens and spring onions, a bamboo grove at the top of the slope, a small timber-and-plaster house with a grey tiled roof and deep eaves
places.spring: a spring-fed stone basin beside the garden path under the bamboo grove: clear water running from a split bamboo pipe into a mossy carved stone trough, ferns around it, wet flat stepping stones
places.kitchen: a small plain timber kitchen with lime-plastered walls: a clay-brick stove with a wide black iron pan set into it and a wood fire under it, a heavy worn wooden worktop, a wide wooden lattice window open onto the valley, a few woven bamboo baskets and plain stoneware jars on one shelf
places.porch: a wooden porch at the front of the small house under the deep tiled eaves, a low worn wooden table and two low stools, the terraces and the misty valley below, a plain paper lamp hanging from the eave

terraces.brief: The terraced garden empty, nobody in it, seen from the top terrace: the dry-stone walls stepping down, the pumpkin vines over the bamboo trellis, the greens, the misty valley beyond, the corner of the small house. Soft grey morning light.

kitchen.brief: The kitchen empty, nobody in it, seen from the doorway: the clay-brick stove with the wide black iron pan, the worn wooden worktop, the lattice window open onto the valley. Bright soft daylight.

porch.brief: The porch empty, nobody on it: the low wooden table and two stools under the deep eaves, the terraces and the misty valley below. Soft daylight.

the basket.brief: A shallow round woven bamboo basket with a bent bamboo handle, empty, standing on a worn wooden worktop. Soft daylight.

Pip.brief: Pip the cat sitting upright on worn wooden floorboards, looking slightly to the side, full body in view, soft daylight.

beats.shot: Wide empty landscape of the terraced hillside in the early mist, no woman and no person anywhere: dry-stone terraces stepping down into a white sea of mist, the bamboo grove dark at the top.
Wide empty view down the terraces into the misty valley, nobody anywhere.
beats.move: Only the mist moves, drifting slowly along the valley below; nothing else moves and no one walks in.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from behind, small in the frame, walking slowly down the narrow stone steps between two terraces, the empty bamboo basket on her arm.
beats.move: She walks slowly down two steps with soft footfalls on stone; the terraces and the camera stay perfectly still.

beats.shot: Close-up of a big rough pumpkin leaf on the trellis with heavy dew drops on it.
beats.move: One dew drop rolls slowly down the leaf and falls; the leaf trembles once and stays.

beats.shot: Close-up among the big pumpkin leaves on the ground: a squat ribbed dusty-orange pumpkin with pale-green streaks and a dry curled stalk resting on dry straw; her hands in undyed linen sleeves lift a leaf to show it.
beats.move: Her hands lift the leaf slowly and hold it; the pumpkin stays where it is.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands in undyed linen sleeves knocking twice on a squat ribbed dusty-orange pumpkin with pale-green streaks and a dry curled stalk on the straw, listening.
beats.move: Her knuckles knock twice on the pumpkin with a hollow sound; the pumpkin stays still.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands in undyed linen sleeves twisting the dry curled stalk of a squat ribbed dusty-orange pumpkin with pale-green streaks and a dry curled stalk until it snaps free of the vine.
beats.move: She twists the stalk slowly and it snaps off the vine with a dry crack.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from the side on the terrace, head bowed, lifting a squat ribbed dusty-orange pumpkin with pale-green streaks and a dry curled stalk from the straw in both arms.
beats.move: She lifts the pumpkin slowly against her chest and straightens up; the camera stays locked off.

beats.shot: Close-up of a row of spring onions in dark soil; her fingers in undyed linen sleeves pull up three of them.
beats.move: She pulls the spring onions up slowly, a little soil falling from the white roots.

beats.shot: Close-up of the bamboo basket on the mossy top of a dry-stone wall outdoors, the dusty-orange pumpkin in it and three spring onions beside it.
beats.move: Her hand lays the spring onions in the basket and draws back; the pumpkin stays where it is.

beats.shot: Close-up of Pip the cat sitting on the mossy dry-stone wall of the terrace in the mist.
beats.move: Pip blinks slowly and his ear turns toward a sound; the wall and the mist stay still.

beats.shot: Close-up of the bamboo grove at the top of the slope in the mist: tall green stems, thin leaves, a narrow earth path between them, no person.
Close-up of the tall green bamboo stems at the top of the terraces in the mist, thin leaves above.
beats.move: Only the bamboo leaves sway and rustle softly in the breeze; nothing else moves and no one walks in.

beats.shot: Close-up of the stone spring basin under the bamboo, no person: clear water running from the split bamboo pipe into the mossy stone trough, ferns around it.
Close-up of the split bamboo pipe pouring a thin clear stream into the mossy stone trough.
beats.move: Only the water moves, falling into the trough and rippling; nothing else moves.

beats.shot: Close-up of the stone trough: her hands in rolled undyed linen sleeves wash the soil off the dusty-orange pumpkin under the running water.
beats.move: Her hands turn the pumpkin slowly under the water and the soil washes away.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands rinsing the three spring onions in the clear stream from the bamboo pipe.
beats.move: The water runs over the white roots and the last soil rinses off.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from behind crouching at the stone trough under the bamboo, head bowed, the clean wet pumpkin on the flat stone beside her.
beats.move: She shakes the water from her hands slowly; the bamboo and the camera stay still.

beats.shot: Wide view of the plain kitchen with nobody in it: the clean dusty-orange pumpkin on the worn worktop, the clay stove, the lattice window open onto the valley.
Close-up of the open fire door of the clay-brick stove: her hand in a rolled linen sleeve feeds in a few dry split sticks.
beats.move: The sticks catch with a soft crackle and small flames lick up; her hand draws back.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of the worn worktop: the dusty-orange pumpkin already cut into thick wedges with bright orange flesh and a hollow of pale seeds; her hands lift one wedge.
beats.move: Her hands slowly lift one wedge and turn it to show the seeds; the other wedges stay where they are.

beats.shot: Close-up of her fingers in rolled linen sleeves scooping the pale wet seeds out of a bright orange pumpkin wedge into a small stoneware bowl.
beats.move: Her fingers scoop the seeds slowly and they drop into the bowl with a wet sound.

beats.shot: Close-up of the small stoneware bowl at the stone spring trough outdoors: her hands rinse the pale pumpkin seeds under the bamboo pipe, rubbing off the orange strings.
beats.move: The water runs through the seeds and her fingers rub them slowly.

beats.shot: Close-up of the wide black iron pan on the clay stove: her hand tips the clean pale pumpkin seeds from the bowl into the dry hot pan.
beats.move: The seeds spill into the pan with a sharp patter and a little steam rises.

beats.shot: Close-up of the wide black iron pan: pale pumpkin seeds toasting, her hand stirring them slowly with a flat wooden paddle.
beats.move: The paddle turns the seeds slowly; a few seeds pop and jump with a small crack.

beats.shot: Close-up of the iron pan: thick bright orange pumpkin wedges laid flesh-down in a little oil, just starting to brown at the edges.
beats.move: The wedges sizzle softly and a thin curl of steam rises; the wedges stay where they are.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from the side at the clay stove, head bowed over the wide iron pan, turning the pumpkin wedges with long wooden chopsticks.
beats.move: She turns one wedge slowly with the chopsticks; smoke from the fire drifts past the lattice window; the camera stays locked off.

beats.shot: Close-up of Pip the cat lying on the worn floorboards near the warm clay stove.
beats.move: Pip stretches one white paw slowly and settles again; nothing else moves.

beats.shot: Close-up of the lattice window open onto the valley: the hills in soft afternoon light, a few clouds, a stoneware jar on the sill, no person.
Top-down close-up of the worn worktop: soft roasted pumpkin wedges with browned edges on a plain stoneware plate, a little steam rising, a small bowl of toasted pumpkin seeds beside it.
Close-up of her hands in rolled linen sleeves peeling the thin skin off a soft roasted pumpkin wedge with her fingers over a stoneware bowl.
beats.move: The skin peels away slowly and the soft orange flesh drops into the bowl.

beats.shot: Close-up of the stoneware bowl of soft roasted orange pumpkin: her hand presses it into a smooth mash with a wooden pestle.
beats.move: The pestle presses down slowly and the pumpkin squashes into a soft orange mash.

beats.shot: Close-up of a black clay pot on the stove: her hand tips spoonfuls of orange pumpkin mash into simmering water.
beats.move: The mash slides in with a soft plop and the water turns orange; steam rises.

beats.shot: Close-up of the black clay pot of thick orange pumpkin soup bubbling gently, steam rising.
beats.move: Bubbles rise slowly through the thick soup with a soft blub; the pot stays still.

beats.shot: Close-up of a wide stoneware bowl: orange pumpkin mash with white flour; her hands knead it into a soft orange dough.
beats.move: Her hands fold and press the dough slowly; a little flour dusts the bowl.

beats.shot: Close-up of the floured worktop: her palms press small balls of orange pumpkin dough into flat round cakes and set them in a row.
beats.move: She presses one ball flat slowly with her palm and lays it beside the others.

beats.shot: Close-up of her fingers pressing a few toasted pumpkin seeds into the top of each flat orange pumpkin cake on the floured worktop.
beats.move: Her fingers press the seeds in slowly one by one; the cakes stay in their row.

beats.shot: Close-up of the wide black iron pan: flat orange pumpkin cakes with seeds on top frying in a little oil.
beats.move: The cakes sizzle steadily and their edges turn golden; a thin steam rises.

beats.shot: Close-up of the iron pan: her chopsticks turn one pumpkin cake over to show a crisp golden-brown underside.
beats.move: The cake flips slowly and lands with a sizzle.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from behind at the lattice window, wiping her hands slowly on her indigo apron while steam rises from the pot on the stove beside her.
beats.move: She wipes her hands slowly and looks out at the valley; the camera stays still.

beats.shot: Wide view of the small house from the terrace below at blue dusk: the deep eaves, the paper lamp lit on the porch, the misty valley, nobody outside.
Close-up of the low wooden table on the porch: her hands in oatmeal wool sleeves set down a plain stoneware bowl and a pair of wooden chopsticks.
beats.move: She sets the bowl down slowly and lays the chopsticks across it.

beats.shot: Close-up of the black clay pot: a wooden ladle in her hand lifts thick orange pumpkin soup and pours it into a stoneware bowl.
beats.move: The soup pours slowly from the ladle into the bowl and steam rises.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of the stoneware bowl of thick orange pumpkin soup on the porch table: her fingers scatter toasted pumpkin seeds and a few green spring onion rings on top.
beats.move: The seeds and onion rings fall slowly onto the soup; steam rises.

beats.shot: Top-down view of the low wooden porch table at dusk: the bowl of orange pumpkin soup with seeds on top, a plate of golden pumpkin cakes, a small cup of tea, wooden chopsticks, the light of the paper lamp from above.
Ellie seen from behind and a little to the side, sitting down on the low stool at the porch table, the blue misty valley beyond.
beats.move: She sits down slowly and tucks her cardigan around her; the lamp and the valley stay still; the camera stays locked off.

beats.shot: Close-up of the plate of golden pumpkin cakes: her chopsticks pick one up and break it in half to show the soft orange inside.
beats.move: The cake breaks slowly with a soft crisp sound and a little steam rises.

beats.shot: Close-up of the bowl of pumpkin soup: a porcelain spoon dips in and lifts thick orange soup with seeds.
beats.move: The spoon lifts slowly out of the soup and out of frame; steam rises.

beats.shot: Close-up of Pip the cat curled on the second low stool on the porch, the light of the paper lamp on his fur.
beats.move: Pip breathes slowly and his ear twitches once; nothing else moves.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from behind on the porch, holding the warm soup bowl in both hands, the blue valley and the first lights far below.
beats.move: She lifts the bowl a little in both hands and holds it; the valley and the lamp stay still.

beats.shot: Wide view from the porch over the dark terraces into the blue misty valley at dusk, nobody anywhere.
beats.move: Only the mist moves slowly along the valley; nothing else moves and no one walks in.

teaser.text: Knock twice. If it sounds hollow, it's ready. This one was.

short.text: one pumpkin, from the vine to dinner
